content.short: Spectrum provides decentralised RPC infrastructure with distributed endpoints for Web3 apps.
content.description: Spectrum runs RPC infrastructure on a decentralised model, spreading endpoints across independent operators. It covers more than 200 networks on enterprise bare-metal hardware the team owns and operates from the firewall up, with 24/7 monitoring and a direct line to its DevOps staff. The service is SOC 2 Type 2 attested and publishes median latency figures. Features include real-time webhooks, agent-ready APIs, a scriptable CLI and team-wide sponsored access.
